stem:
[Image: Row of 4 squares made of matches]

In the figure, 13 matches were used to make 4 squares in a row. What is the number of squares in a row that can be made in this way using 73 matches? Show the calculations that lead to your answer.

Answer: ____

codes.response: 24 with no calculations or no relevant calculations (includes only drawing and counting squares)
Incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible or off task)

figure_description: Four squares connected in a single horizontal row, sharing common vertical sides, constructed from 13 matchsticks: 4 horizontal matchsticks along the top (heads pointing right), 4 horizontal matchsticks along the bottom (heads pointing left), and 5 vertical matchsticks dividing and enclosing the squares (heads pointing up).
